# Work Card: Add Architect framing prompt composer

## Work Card ID

WC03

Created: 2026-06-29T00:00:00.000Z
Updated: 2026-06-29T00:00:00.000Z

## Phase

phase-01

## Status

ready_for_builder

## What Problem Are We Solving?

ChampCity A/I needs a manual Architect framing step that turns saved draft Work Cards into copy-ready Architect prompts without calling an LLM API or marking the draft Builder-ready.

## What Should This Accomplish?

Add an Electron Architect Prompt Composer that lists saved Work Card JSON files, generates a copy-ready Architect framing prompt, copies it to the clipboard, and saves the prompt as durable Markdown.

## What Should the User Be Able To Do?

The Operator can select a saved draft Work Card, review a generated Architect framing prompt, copy it, and save the prompt artifact under the phase planning folder.

## What Is Included?

- Add minimal navigation between `New Work Card` and `Architect Prompt Composer`.
- Add constrained main/preload IPC support to list and read Work Card JSON files under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Work_Cards/`.
- Validate loaded Work Card JSON with the existing Work Card validator before prompt generation.
- Build a simple Work Card selector that shows Work Card ID, title, status, and phase.
- Show a warning when the selected Work Card status is not `ready_for_architect`.
- Add a shared Architect framing prompt renderer.
- Show the generated Architect prompt in a readable, copyable preview.
- Add `Copy Prompt` behavior using browser clipboard APIs with a plain-language fallback error.
- Add constrained IPC support to save Architect prompt Markdown under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Architect_Prompts/`.
- Create the WC03 Work Card artifact and Builder Report.
- Extend lightweight Work Card validation coverage for Architect prompt rendering and path safety.

## What Is Not Included?

- Do not call an LLM API.
- Do not implement automatic Architect reasoning.
- Do not generate the final Builder prompt.
- Do not modify selected Work Card JSON or Markdown.
- Do not change Work Card status or mark anything as `ready_for_builder` from the UI.
- Do not implement Work Card editing.
- Do not implement risk router behavior.
- Do not implement Builder Report capture workflow.
- Do not implement validation/repair loop.
- Do not add provider integrations, databases, cloud services, auth, deployment automation, MCP integrations, or connector integrations.
- Do not perform a broad UI redesign.

## Requirements

- Default the Architect Prompt Composer phase to `phase-01`.
- Renderer code must not read or write files directly.
- Filesystem reads and writes must be mediated by constrained main/preload IPC.
- IPC must normalize and validate paths, reject traversal, reject arbitrary absolute paths, restrict phase names to safe values, and read only `.json` Work Card files.
- Save Architect prompts with filenames matching `ARCHITECT_PROMPT_<work_card_id>_<slug>.md`.
- The generated prompt must instruct the Architect to ask only necessary clarifying questions, provide recommended defaults, explain options plainly, push back on scope creep, and keep Builder work narrow and testable.
- The generated prompt must include the selected Work Card structured content in readable form.
- The generated prompt must state: `Do not produce the final Builder prompt until the Operator confirms or corrects the Architect framing decisions.`
- WC03 must not edit Work Cards or produce a final Builder prompt.

## How We Know This Is Done

- Navigation shows `New Work Card` and `Architect Prompt Composer`.
- The Architect Prompt Composer lists saved Work Card JSON files for `phase-01`.
- Selecting a Work Card displays its ID, title, phase, and status.
- A warning appears if the selected Work Card is not `ready_for_architect`.
- The generated prompt is visible and includes the selected Work Card ID and title.
- The generated prompt asks the Architect to ask only necessary clarifying questions.
- The generated prompt tells the Architect to provide recommended defaults.
- The generated prompt says not to produce the final Builder prompt until Operator confirmation.
- `Copy Prompt` works or shows a plain-language fallback error.
- Saving creates Markdown under `planning/phases/phase-01/Architect_Prompts/`.
- Work Card JSON and Markdown files are not modified by the composer.
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:work-cards` pass.

## How This Should Be Validated

- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Run `npm run build`.
- Run `npm test`.
- Run `npm run test:work-cards`.
- Run `git status --short` and review changed files.
- Manually run `npm start` to validate the Electron UI.

## Risk Level

medium

## Risks and Watch Items

- Manual Electron UI validation is still required because no renderer smoke test exists yet.
- Path safety must remain constrained as new planning artifact folders are added.
- Prompt wording must preserve the Architect boundary and avoid implying automatic implementation.

## Builder Instructions

- Verify the repository path before editing.
- Read `AGENTS.md`, the WC01 and WC02 Builder Reports, and the existing WC01 and WC02 Work Card artifacts before implementation.
- Keep the pass limited to WC03 Architect prompt composition, constrained IPC, prompt saving, validation coverage, the WC03 Work Card artifact, and the Builder Report.
- Do not call LLM APIs, generate final Builder prompts, modify selected Work Cards, update Work Card statuses, add provider SDKs, or implement unrelated features.
- Run the required validation commands and document results in the Builder Report.
- Stage only files created or modified for WC03 and commit with `feat: add architect framing prompt composer`.

## Operator Notes

- A Work Card should never be authored by the Operator alone.
- WC03 generates an Architect framing prompt only.
- The Architect remains responsible for translating captured Operator intent into a Builder-ready Work Card.
- The final Builder prompt must wait until the Operator confirms or corrects the Architect framing decisions.
